files.name: CHANGELOG.md
files.body:
### Added
- Sessions: a new session starts with the sport, spot, equipment (still active) and water and air temperatures of the most recent session; a short note above the form says so.

### Changed
- GPS track: for a new session, the sport and the spot suggested by the track replace those taken from the last session.
